title: Trump Becomes First President With a Mugshot
description_short: Trump Becomes First President With a Mugshot
description_medium: On August 24, 2023, Donald Trump surrendered at Fulton County Jail in Atlanta, Georgia, becoming the first former U.S. president to have a mugshot taken. Trump was booked on Georgia RICO charges under booking number P01135809. The scowling image immediately went viral worldwide. Trump posted the image on X within hours and his campaign began selling mugshot merchandise within the day. The spectacle illustrated the normalization of criminal charges against a major party candidate.
description_long: On August 24, 2023, Donald Trump surrendered at Fulton County Jail in Atlanta in the Georgia racketeering case, and authorities took his booking photograph. The indictment had been returned ten days earlier; the jail visit was his surrender for processing in that case. He was the first former U.S. president to have a mugshot taken. The image circulated quickly; Trump posted it on X within hours, and his campaign began selling merchandise featuring it that day. A routine step in the booking process thus became a campaign image and fundraising product. The episode joined a criminal proceeding with electoral politics: Trump was a leading Republican candidate while facing charges in Georgia. The booking and indictment were not a conviction; they marked the start of a legal process whose merits would be addressed in court. The photo’s rapid circulation also made the moment a major public spectacle.
